events.description: After a copy of the new-item template was added: fill in its content here.
events.name: ok:sortable:add

events.description: Before an item moves from index `from` to `to`. Call `preventDefault()` to keep the order.
events.detail: { from: number; to: number; item: HTMLElement; }
events.name: ok:sortable:move

events.description: Before an item is removed. Call `preventDefault()` to keep it.
events.name: ok:sortable:remove

events.description: Before an item moves to another list of its group (`data-ok-group`), at `index` in `to`. Fires on the list it leaves. Call `preventDefault()` to keep it.
events.detail: { item: HTMLElement; from: HTMLElement; to: HTMLElement; index: number; }
events.name: ok:sortable:transfer

methods.description: Appends a clone of `template[data-ok-sortable-template]`; returns it (or `null`).
methods.name: add

methods.description: Moves an item. Returns `false` if out of range or `ok:sortable:move` was prevented.
methods.name: move

methods.description: Removes an item. Returns `false` if out of range or `ok:sortable:remove` was prevented.
methods.name: remove

methods.description: Moves the item at `index` to another sortable list (an element or its `id`), at `toIndex` (default: its end). Returns `false` if out of range or `ok:sortable:transfer` was prevented.
methods.name: transfer
methods.type: (index: number, to: string | HTMLElement, toIndex?: number | undefined) => boolean

options.description: Grid, one column or one scrolling row.
options.name: layout

parts.description: On the list: the groups it takes items from, separated by spaces (default: its own group).
parts.name: data-ok-accept

parts.description: Set by the runtime on the item being dragged.
parts.name: data-ok-dragging

parts.description: Set by the runtime on the item grabbed with the keyboard.
parts.name: data-ok-grabbed

parts.description: On the list: the group it belongs to. Items move between lists of the same group.
parts.name: data-ok-group

parts.description: The buttons at the end of an item.
parts.name: data-ok-sortable-actions

parts.description: HTML only: the button that adds a copy of the new-item template.
parts.name: data-ok-sortable-add

parts.description: A visually hidden live region that announces moves. Created once per page.
parts.name: data-ok-sortable-announcer

parts.description: The handle that drags an item, or moves it with the keyboard.
parts.name: data-ok-sortable-handle

parts.description: On a button or menu item inside an item: the `id` of the list it moves the item to (its end).
parts.name: data-ok-sortable-move-to

parts.description: The button that removes its item.
parts.name: data-ok-sortable-remove

parts.description: HTML only: the markup of new items.
parts.name: data-ok-sortable-template

react.description: A controlled list reordered by dragging the handle, by keyboard (Space, arrows, Escape) or by two taps. Name it with `aria-label`.

props.description: The groups this list takes items from (default: its own `group`). Set it to take items from other groups, such as a "Done" list that takes tasks but gives none back.
props.name: accept

props.description: Name used in the handle / remove labels ("Reorder …", "Remove …").
props.name: getItemLabel

props.description: Stable identity of an item (React key).
props.name: getKey

props.description: Connects lists: items move between lists of the page with the same group (drag, keys, taps, move-to triggers). Give each list an `id`.
props.name: group

props.description: Grid, one column or one scrolling row.
props.name: layout

props.description: Renders a remove button per item and is called when one is pressed.
props.name: onRemove

props.description: Called with the reordered items (controlled: render them to apply the move).
props.name: onReorder

props.description: Called when an item of this list moves to another list. Update both lists, for example with `moveBetweenLists(lists, event)`. Without it, items never leave the list.
props.name: onTransfer
